summary: Iteration 139: Tested Webinar Mode, Gamification Leaderboard, and File Sharing features. All 9 backend API tests passed. All frontend features verified working: Webinars nav item, webinar management page with 4 webinars, create webinar dialog, webinar registration page (now public), gamification card with collapsible leaderboard showing 8 entries from 207 users, and File Sharing button in More Menu dropdown inside meeting room.

backend_apis.webinar_list: PASS - GET /api/karau/webinar/list returns webinars array with status, registered_count
backend_apis.webinar_create: PASS - POST /api/karau/webinar/create creates webinar with webinar_id, registration_url, join_url
backend_apis.webinar_get_public: PASS - GET /api/karau/webinar/{id} returns webinar details (public endpoint)
backend_apis.gamification: PASS - GET /api/karau/analytics/gamification returns level, xp, xp_to_next, badges, rank_title
backend_apis.leaderboard: PASS - GET /api/karau/analytics/leaderboard returns leaderboard array with my_rank, total_users
backend_apis.effectiveness: PASS - GET /api/karau/analytics/effectiveness returns score, engagement_level, tip

frontend_ui.sidebar_webinars_nav: PASS - 'Webinars' item in sidebar navigates to /karau-meet/webinars
frontend_ui.webinar_management_page: PASS - Shows 4 webinars with status badges (Ended, Scheduled), registration counts, Start/Copy Link buttons
frontend_ui.create_webinar_dialog: PASS - Opens with Title, Description, Date/Time, Max Attendees, Panelist Emails, Q&A/Chat/Video toggles
frontend_ui.webinar_registration_page: PASS - Public page at /karau-meet/webinar/{id}/register shows form with Name, Email, Organization
frontend_ui.gamification_card: PASS - Dashboard shows Newcomer rank, Lv.1, #15 rank button, 0 XP, 0 meetings, 0 hours
frontend_ui.leaderboard_toggle: PASS - Clicking #15 button expands TEAM LEADERBOARD with 8 entries from 207 members
frontend_ui.file_sharing_more_menu: PASS - More Menu dropdown contains File Sharing option
frontend_ui.file_sharing_panel: PASS - Panel shows Upload File button, link sharing input, empty state, 10MB limit note

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: Webinar registration page route was behind authentication - moved to public routes before auth check
All webinar CRUD operations properly use host_id for authorization
Gamification XP calculation includes meetings, hosted, AI notes, and hours
Leaderboard correctly shows my_rank position and returns top 50 entries
File Sharing panel implements P2P sharing via WebSocket with 10MB limit
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Webinar_Iteration139 webinar via API test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 139 verified all 3 new features: 1) Webinar Mode - full CRUD + registration + host controls, 2) Gamification Leaderboard - collapsible in dashboard gamification card showing XP/level/badges/rank, 3) File Sharing - accessible via More Menu in meeting room with P2P sharing. The webinar registration page was fixed to be publicly accessible (no login required). All APIs return correct data structures. The karau purple theme is consistent throughout.
